title: Correlated by Construction: Endpoint Choice and the Validation of Protein Screening
abstract: arXiv:2611.30087v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning for protein engineering depends on functional measurements collected at screening scale, but the designs those measurements rank are deployed in processes that run elsewhere. Whether a miniaturized assay remains informative under the conditions of use is usually assumed rather than demonstrated. We describe an automated production and screening platform and test the transfer of its solution-phase metal-affinity measurements to immobilized rare-earth separation. Primary pKd-derived separation factors tracked those measured on covalently immobilized protein across 82 protein-metal-pair measurements from 35 proteins, with pairwise Spearman correlations of 0.878 to 0.923 (pooled Pearson $r$ = 0.836; Spearman $\rho$ = 0.869). Separation factors at a fixed metal pair are insensitive to the ordering shared across the lanthanide series, so these coefficients report protein-specific correspondence directly; permutation of protein

translated_title: 构建即相关：终点选择与蛋白质筛选的验证
translated_abstract: 面向蛋白质工程的机器学习依赖于在筛选规模上收集的功能测量数据，但这些测量所排序出的设计却会被部署在别处运行的工艺流程中。小型化测定在实际使用条件下是否仍然具有参考价值，通常只是被默认假设而未经证实。我们描述了一个自动化生产与筛选平台，并测试了其溶液相金属亲和力测量数据向固定化稀土分离的迁移效果。在来自35种蛋白质的82个蛋白质-金属对测量中，由pKd（解离常数）推导的分离因子与在共价固定化蛋白质上测得的分离因子保持一致，两两Spearman相关系数为0.878至0.923（合并Pearson r = 0.836；Spearman ρ = 0.869）。在固定金属对条件下，分离因子对镧系元素系列中共享的排序并不敏感，因此这些相关系数直接反映了蛋白质特异性的对应关系……
tldr: 该研究构建了一个自动化生产与筛选平台，证实溶液相pKd测量推导的分离因子与固定化蛋白质的稀土分离性能高度相关（Spearman ρ达0.869–0.923），从而实证验证了筛选终点选择向实际部署条件迁移的有效性。
en_tdlr: This study validates protein screening endpoint choice by demonstrating that solution-phase pKd-derived separation factors from an automated production and screening platform strongly correlate with immobilized rare-earth separation performance across 35 proteins (Spearman ρ = 0.869–0.923).
